_what: Deliberately-distinct problem ids. Each entry is ONE adjudicated decision naming a SET of ids that are correctly separate from one another; problem_id_collision_gate suppresses every pair drawn from that set. This is the registration path PLA-449 asks for: a near-duplicate id is very often correct host or pathogen scoping, and a decision written down here stops the gate re-asking it every batch.
_how_to_add: Register only after ADJUDICATING the organisms, never to quiet the gate. State the reason in terms of the taxon or the scope the two entries actually cover -- not the id strings -- and cite where the ruling was made. An id pair that is genuinely one problem does NOT belong here; merge the ids instead.
